summary:
SECOND RUN of the decoupling packet. Run 1 returned request_changes. C1-C3 PASSED. Failures were Z1/W1/W2 about the sweep (silent omit of missing Deliverables, unreadable files skipped, symlink targets outside labelled as inside). Those sweep honesty defects are REPAIRED in packet 2 (repairs range, WO-OR-14 and WO-OR-17). This packet is INTERMEDIATE post-decoupling code — you will still SEE those defects here. Do NOT re-block the decoupling on them; they are recorded and fixed later. Judge only whether the DECOUPLING itself was surgical (C1-C3) and any NEW defect the decoupling introduced.

SPLIT PACKET 1 of 2 — tools/governor/reorient.mjs, THE DECOUPLING ONLY (range a989e68..2aac7d9). WHY THIS IS SPLIT, stated plainly because a split packet must never be mistaken for a whole one. reorient.mjs's full diff against the merge base is 80,945 bytes against this tool's 60,000-byte cap, so it cannot be reviewed in one packet and would truncate silently — a truncated review is a verdict over ground the reviewer never examined, which is the exact failure this phase exists to treat. The change is therefore gated in two range packets. THIS PACKET is the surgical decoupling. PACKET 2 (2aac7d9..HEAD) covers everything done since, which is the repair of the location block's honesty, and is reviewed separately under its own claim. THE LIMIT THAT FOLLOWS, disclosed rather than implied: NO SINGLE REVIEWER SEES THE COMPLETE FINAL FILE. Each acceptance criterion is gated exactly once, by a reviewer that can see the code it concerns. CONTEXT. BUILD-018 built a session governor that enforced 0 of its 4 intended rules and is being torn down surgically rather than blind-reverted, because a revert would take genuinely useful components with it. reorient.mjs SURVIVES. It is the SessionStart hook — the first thing that speaks in every session, telling the operator where the session actually is. WHAT THIS RANGE DOES. reorient.mjs is decoupled from the two deleted modules it depended on, falling from 1265 lines to 347. It previously walked the whole estate looking for Deliverables/*/programme-state.json, collapsed multiple checkouts, and assessed the freshness of banked programme commits; all of that is deleted along with programme-state.mjs and rotate-session.mjs. What remains is the three behaviours worth keeping: the sweep of loose Deliverables/*.md plans, the passthrough of the Honcho continuity brief, and repository/worktree/branch/HEAD verification by real git calls. Exactly one four-line helper, normaliseSeparators, was inlined from the deleted rotate-session.mjs. Its sibling isBankingCommit was deliberately NOT inlined, because its only consumer was the deleted freshness assessment — inlining it would have re-grown a corpse, and a comment records that reasoning rather than leaving it to be rediscovered. WHAT THIS PACKET DOES NOT ASK YOU TO JUDGE, and why you will see code that looks wrong. This range contains the location block AS IT WAS IMMEDIATELY AFTER THE DECOUPLING, before it was repaired. Its honesty defects are KNOWN, were found by independent review of this very range, and are fixed in packet 2: the cwd was echoed from hook input rather than measured, a non-string cwd rendered as a path, a cwd resolving to a file rendered as an established location, branch rendered the literal 'HEAD' when detached, and upstream asserted nothing was pushed on the strength of a probe that answers a different question. DO NOT re-report those; they are recorded and repaired. This packet asks only whether the DECOUPLING itself was surgical. WHAT IS NOT CLAIMED: the tests live in reorient.test.mjs, whose diff also exceeds the cap and CANNOT be staged, so they get no independent read at all — and that suite is additionally excluded from CI, making this module the one component of the teardown with neither. continuity.mjs and continuity-derive.mjs have NO tests whatsoever. All evidence is builder self-test plus my own independent re-run. It is NOT independent review.
brief_excerpt:
Judge this diff against these criteria and ONLY these. They were written BEFORE the diff existed, derived from the work order rather than from the code, so they cannot be back-fitted to what was built.

SCOPE — read this first. This packet contains tools/governor/reorient.mjs ONLY, and ONLY the range a989e68..2aac7d9, which is the DECOUPLING. The packet's diff_range states this explicitly. Rows about any other file are OUT OF SCOPE — mark them not_applicable, never blocked.

HAND-CARRIED PRIOR FINDINGS — DISCLOSED. Run 1 sweep silence + symlink findings are fixed in the repairs packet, not here. Do not treat them as decoupling blockers.

CRITICAL SCOPE NOTE — you will see defective code, and it is not what you are being asked about. The location block in this range renders values it did not measure. Those defects were found by independent review OF THIS EXACT RANGE, are recorded, and are repaired in a separate packet covering 2aac7d9..HEAD. Specifically excluded from this packet's judgement: the cwd being echoed rather than measured; a non-string cwd; a cwd resolving to a file; the literal 'HEAD' rendered as a branch when detached; and the upstream sentence being gated on the wrong probe. Do not re-report them. Judge whether the DECOUPLING was surgical. If you find something ELSE — including anything the decoupling itself broke — report it fully.

The tests for this module are in reorient.test.mjs, which cannot be staged untruncated and is NOT in this packet. Do not report tests as missing, and do not infer from their absence that they do not exist.

C1. reorient.mjs no longer imports programme-state.mjs or rotate-session.mjs. Both are DELETED in this teardown, so a surviving import would not be untidy — it would be a hard runtime failure at session start, on the hook that runs first in every session.

C2. The three preserved behaviours all SURVIVE the decoupling and are genuinely reachable in the shipped code path:
  (a) the sweep of loose Deliverables/*.md plans;
  (b) the Honcho continuity brief passthrough;
  (c) repository / worktree / branch / HEAD verification by real git calls.
Verify each is wired into the hook's OUTPUT, not merely present as an exported function nothing calls. An orphaned export that no path reaches satisfies a grep and fails this criterion. For (c) judge only that the git calls are made and reach the output — whether each rendered value is HONEST about what it measured is packet 2's question, not this one.

C3. Exactly ONE helper, normaliseSeparators, was inlined from the deleted rotate-session.mjs. isBankingCommit was NOT inlined, deliberately, because its only consumer was the deleted assessBankedFreshness. Confirm no other symbol was quietly carried across from either deleted module, and that nothing arrived with no caller. A helper carried across with its consumer deleted is dead code that a later reader mistakes for protection.

Z1. The hook must never THROW and must always exit 0. It runs at session start; if it throws, the operator's first contact with the session is a crash or, worse, silence. Verify a missing Deliverables directory, an unreadable file, an absent continuity brief, and a git call that fails or returns nothing each degrade to a reported absence rather than an exception.

ADVERSARIAL ROWS — answer even if every row above passes.
W1. Did the decoupling BREAK anything it was supposed to preserve? A behaviour that survives as code but no longer reaches the output is the failure mode that matters here, because it degrades every future session's opening in a way indistinguishable from a session with nothing to report.
W2. Can the deliverables sweep miss a file it should report, or report one it should not? Consider unreadable entries, symlinks, deeply nested paths, case sensitivity on a case-insensitive filesystem, and malformed frontmatter.
W3. normaliseSeparators was inlined from deleted code. Does its inlined form behave identically at every use site that depends on it — UNC paths, mixed separators, trailing separators?
W4. Is there any REMAINING coupling to programme-state — by filename, by convention, by directory layout, or by an assumption about what exists on disk — that a grep for imports would not catch? The deletion is the point of this range, so a surviving hidden dependency is the most valuable thing you could find.

OUT OF SCOPE — do not report as defects: the location block's honesty, which is packet 2 and is listed above in detail; which modules the operator chose to keep or delete, a product decision; prose, naming or comment-style preference; the absence of tests from this packet; the exclusion of reorient.test.mjs from CI, disclosed and the operator's to close; and the absence of malicious-handler hardening, since this estate's bar is correctness, accidental leak, availability and audit for a first-party personal system, not a hostile-input service.
